bench-retrieval.help: Measure retrieval latency per retriever (index load and per query).

params.help: Results per query (default: the largest eval_k_list value).
params.name: k

build-corpus.help: Build processed corpus artifacts from a SQuAD-style subset dataset.

build-index.help: Build retrieval indexes (BM25 and/or dense ChromaDB) from chunks.jsonl.

params.help: Build the dense ChromaDB chunk index.
params.name: dense

eval-answers.help: Evaluate generated answers against gold answers for an existing RAG run log.

eval-retrieval.help: Run deterministic retrieval-only evaluation on all questions.

params.help: Replay the queries of this run log (each question's logged rewrites, fused with RRF) instead of the raw questions.
params.name: queries_from_log

judge.help: Evaluate saved RAG run logs with a strict reference-guided LLM judge.

params.help: Explicitly allow real LLM calls to the judge model (costs API usage).
params.name: allow_llm_calls

make-subset.help: Create a deterministic QA subset from a SQuAD-style dataset.

report.help: Generate deterministic thesis-final QA, latency, and cost reports from run logs.

params.help: Questions with gold answers, to count rewrites that leak an answer (default: data/eval/questions.jsonl if it exists).
params.name: questions_path

rewrite-batch.help: Rewrite a question set into the rewrite cache (e.g. a dev split).

params.help: Call the rewrite model for questions not in the cache (needs its API key).
params.name: allow_llm_calls

run.help: Run the deterministic LangGraph RAG workflow for one question.

params.help: Explicitly enable live LLM-backed rewriting, guard repair, and answer generation.
params.name: generate

run-batch.help: Run the deterministic RAG workflow over multiple qids using one explicit preloaded context.

params.help: Explicitly enable live LLM-backed rewriting, guard repair, and answer generation.
params.name: generate

validate.help: Validate processed and evaluation JSONL artifacts.
